import {
  defineApp,
  nav,
  Screen,
  Stack,
  Row,
  Card,
  Divider,
  Text,
  Icon,
  Button,
  List,
  ListItem,
  EmptyState,
  Modal,
  TextInput,
  ProgressBar,
  toast,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  storage,
  type SchemaArtifact,
} from 'vc-sdk';

// Flashcards: the cards due today, in due-date order, are reviewed one at a time. Marking a card
// known pushes it further out on a small spacing ladder, so tomorrow's list stays short. The deck
// is one kv value; the session queue and cursor live at module level because a screen gets only
// its own name.
const SCHEMA: SchemaArtifact = { schemaVersion: 1, collections: {} };

const DAY = 86_400_000;
// Days until a card comes back, by how many times it has already been marked known.
const INTERVALS = [1, 3, 7, 14, 30];

interface Card {
  id: number;
  front: string;
  back: string;
  due: number;
  streak: number;
}

const DEFAULT_CARDS: Card[] = [
  { id: 1, front: 'What is the capital of Australia?', back: 'Canberra', due: Date.now() - 2 * DAY - 3_600_000, streak: 0 },
  { id: 2, front: 'What is 7 × 8?', back: '56', due: Date.now() - DAY, streak: 1 },
  { id: 3, front: 'Who wrote Pride and Prejudice?', back: 'Jane Austen', due: Date.now() - 5 * 3_600_000, streak: 0 },
  { id: 4, front: 'Which planet is the largest in our solar system?', back: 'Jupiter', due: Date.now() - 600_000, streak: 2 },
  { id: 5, front: 'What gas do plants take in to make food?', back: 'Carbon dioxide', due: Date.now() - 2 * 3_600_000, streak: 1 },
  { id: 6, front: 'How many continents are there on Earth?', back: 'Seven', due: Date.now() + 3 * DAY, streak: 3 },
];

// The deck, the ids due in this session, where we are in it, and whether one is running.
let cards: Card[] = [];
let dueQueue: number[] = [];
let currentIndex = 0;
let sessionActive = false;

function startOfToday(): number {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.getTime();
}

function endOfToday(): number {
  return startOfToday() + DAY;
}

function dueNow(all: Card[]): Card[] {
  const cutoff = endOfToday();
  return all.filter((c) => c.due < cutoff).sort((a, b) => a.due - b.due);
}

function dueLabel(due: number): string {
  const today = startOfToday();
  if (due >= today) return 'Due today';
  const days = Math.round((today - due) / DAY);
  return days <= 1 ? 'Due yesterday' : `Due ${days} days ago`;
}

function nextId(all: Card[]): number {
  return all.reduce((max, c) => Math.max(max, c.id), 0) + 1;
}

function toCards(value: unknown): Card[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.map((row, i) => {
    const r = row as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
      id: typeof r.id === 'number' ? r.id : i + 1,
      front: String(r.front ?? ''),
      back: String(r.back ?? ''),
      due: typeof r.due === 'number' ? r.due : Date.now(),
      streak: typeof r.streak === 'number' ? r.streak : 0,
    };
  });
}

function Due() {
  const [list, setList] = useState<Card[]>([]);
  const [later, setLater] = useState(0);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [front, setFront] = useState('');
  const [back, setBack] = useState('');
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState<Card | null>(null);

  const show = (all: Card[]) => {
    setList(dueNow(all));
    setLater(all.filter((c) => c.due >= endOfToday()).length);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      const saved = await storage.kv.get('cards');
      let loaded: Card[];
      if (Array.isArray(saved)) {
        loaded = toCards(saved);
      } else {
        loaded = DEFAULT_CARDS;
        await storage.kv.set('cards', loaded);
      }
      if (!live) return;
      cards = loaded;
      show(loaded);
      setReady(true);
    })().catch(() => {
      if (!live) return;
      cards = DEFAULT_CARDS;
      show(DEFAULT_CARDS);
      setReady(true);
      toast('Couldn’t load your deck.');
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const addCard = () => {
    const next: Card[] = [
      ...cards,
      { id: nextId(cards), front: front.trim(), back: back.trim(), due: Date.now(), streak: 0 },
    ];
    cards = next;
    show(next);
    setAdding(false);
    setFront('');
    setBack('');
    storage.kv
      .set('cards', next)
      .then(() => toast('Card added'))
      .catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save that card.'));
  };

  const removeCard = (card: Card) => {
    const next = cards.filter((c) => c.id !== card.id);
    cards = next;
    show(next);
    setOpened(null);
    storage.kv
      .set('cards', next)
      .then(() => toast('Card removed'))
      .catch(() => toast('Couldn’t remove that card.'));
  };

  const start = () => {
    dueQueue = list.map((c) => c.id);
    currentIndex = 0;
    sessionActive = true;
    if (dueQueue.length === 0) {
      nav.navigate('Done');
      return;
    }
    nav.navigate('Review');
  };

  return (
    <Screen title="Flashcards" action={{ icon: 'plus', label: 'Add a card', onPress: () => setAdding(true) }}>
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <Card>
          <Stack gap="sm">
            <Row justify="between">
              <Text>Due today</Text>
              <Text size="title" color="primary">{String(list.length)}</Text>
            </Row>
            <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">
              {later === 0
                ? 'Nothing else scheduled yet.'
                : `${later} more ${later === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'} scheduled for later.`}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Card>

        {list.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={ready ? 'square-check' : 'hourglass'}
            title={ready ? 'Nothing due today' : 'Loading your deck'}
            hint={ready ? 'Tap + to add a card, or come back tomorrow.' : undefined}
          />
        ) : (
          <List
            items={list}
            keyBy="id"
            renderItem={(card) => (
              <ListItem
                title={card.front}
                subtitle={dueLabel(card.due)}
                icon="notebook-pen"
                onPress={() => setOpened(card)}
              />
            )}
          />
        )}

        <Button label="Start review" icon="list-checks" disabled={list.length === 0} onPress={start} />
      </Stack>

      <Modal visible={adding} title="Add a card" onClose={() => setAdding(false)}>
        <TextInput label="Front" value={front} placeholder="What is the capital of Australia?" onChange={setFront} />
        <TextInput label="Back" value={back} placeholder="Canberra" onChange={setBack} />
        <Button label="Add card" icon="plus" disabled={front.trim() === ''} onPress={addCard} />
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={opened !== null} title="Card" onClose={() => setOpened(null)}>
        {opened && (
          <Stack gap="lg">
            <Stack gap="xs">
              <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Front</Text>
              <Text>{opened.front}</Text>
            </Stack>
            <Stack gap="xs">
              <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Back</Text>
              <Text>{opened.back === '' ? 'No answer written for this card.' : opened.back}</Text>
            </Stack>
            <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">
              {opened.streak === 0 ? 'Not reviewed yet.' : `Marked known ${opened.streak} ${opened.streak === 1 ? 'time' : 'times'}.`}
            </Text>
            <Row>
              <Button label="Remove" variant="danger" icon="trash-2" onPress={() => removeCard(opened)} />
              <Button label="Done" variant="secondary" onPress={() => setOpened(null)} />
            </Row>
          </Stack>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </Screen>
  );
}

function Review() {
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(currentIndex);
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false);

  const current = cards.find((c) => c.id === dueQueue[pos]);

  const markKnown = () => {
    if (current === undefined) return;
    const gap = INTERVALS[Math.min(current.streak, INTERVALS.length - 1)];
    const next = cards.map((c) =>
      c.id === current.id ? { ...c, streak: c.streak + 1, due: startOfToday() + gap * DAY } : c,
    );
    cards = next;
    storage.kv.set('cards', next).catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save that card.'));

    const nextIndex = pos + 1;
    currentIndex = nextIndex;
    if (nextIndex >= dueQueue.length) {
      nav.navigate('Done');
      return;
    }
    setPos(nextIndex);
    setRevealed(false);
  };

  if (!sessionActive || current === undefined) {
    return (
      <Screen title="Review">
        <EmptyState icon="circle-check" title="Session complete" hint="Tap back to return to your cards." />
        <Button label="See summary" icon="arrow-right" onPress={() => nav.navigate('Done')} />
      </Screen>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Screen title="Review">
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <ProgressBar value={(pos + 1) / dueQueue.length} label={`${pos + 1} of ${dueQueue.length}`} />

        <Card>
          <Stack gap="lg">
            <Stack gap="xs">
              <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Front</Text>
              <Text size="subtitle">{current.front}</Text>
            </Stack>
            {revealed ? (
              <>
                <Divider />
                <Stack gap="xs">
                  <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Back</Text>
                  <Text>{current.back === '' ? 'No answer written for this card.' : current.back}</Text>
                </Stack>
              </>
            ) : null}
          </Stack>
        </Card>

        {revealed ? (
          <Button label="Mark as known" icon="check" onPress={markKnown} />
        ) : (
          <Button label="Show answer" onPress={() => setRevealed(true)} />
        )}

        <Text size="caption" color="text-muted" align="center">
          {revealed
            ? 'Known cards come back later, further apart each time.'
            : 'Answer it in your head, then check yourself.'}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

function Done() {
  const reviewed = dueQueue.length;
  return (
    <Screen title="Session complete">
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <Card>
          <Stack gap="md">
            <Row gap="sm">
              <Icon name="circle-check" size="lg" color="positive" />
              <Text size="subtitle">All caught up</Text>
            </Row>
            <Text color="text-muted">
              {reviewed} {reviewed === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'} marked as known. Each one is scheduled further out, so
              tomorrow’s list stays short.
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Card>
        <Button label="Back" icon="arrow-left" onPress={() => nav.back()} />
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

export default defineApp({
  name: 'Flashcards',
  initial: 'Due',
  screens: { Due, Review, Done },
  capabilities: ['storage'],
  schema: SCHEMA,
  tint: ['violet', 'indigo', 'slate'],
  icon: 'brain',
});
